concepts.title: Smaragdblatt
concepts.prompt: Create one finished premium mobile game app icon for WEEDTOPIA, a cozy cannabis-growing city-building and management game. Square 1:1 composition, native high resolution. Concept 1: THE EMERALD LEAF EMBLEM. One large, unmistakable seven-point cannabis leaf centered, sculpted lush jade and emerald green, with warm lime highlights and a thin rich golden bevel, within a substantial circular gold medallion. Deep petrol and teal blue-green full-bleed background with a subtle soft radial glow. A small amount of warm sunshine highlights gives a welcoming, prosperous world-building mood. Match the illustrated game's visual identity: hand-painted polished 2.5D fantasy game art, rounded tactile forms, warm cream-gold accents, sophisticated rather than childish. Strong silhouette, bold simple shape hierarchy, excellent separation, highly recognizable at 48–64 pixels. The main motif fills approximately 72% of the canvas, all critical content safely inside a centered circular crop. Keep background opaque and fill all four square corners. No baked rounded-square outer border, no transparency, no phone mockup, no tiny decorative details, no text, no letters, no caption, no watermark. This is an actual standalone launcher icon asset, not a presentation layout or multiple icons.
concepts.description: Ein großes Smaragdblatt auf einer goldenen Münze. Direkter Themenbezug und eine klare Silhouette.

concepts.title: Die grüne Stadt
concepts.prompt: Create one finished premium mobile game app icon for WEEDTOPIA, a cozy cannabis-growing city-building and management game. Square 1:1, native high resolution. Concept 2: A LITTLE GREEN CITY. A single compact, charming isometric town emblem: one substantial honey-colored cozy cafe with a broad jade-green roof in the front, one simple small glass greenhouse beside it, and a short cream-gold tower behind. A large sculptural emerald cannabis leaf rises behind the group as the recognizable silhouette. A bright turquoise river crescent beneath the buildings. Treat these as four large chunky masses, omit small windows, signs, streets, people and landscape clutter. Welcoming sunlit mood, rich deep petrol background fading into lighter teal around the town. Illustrated premium hand-painted 2.5D game art, slightly stylized rounded tactile forms, warm gold edges and cream stone, harmonious with a lush Mediterranean town beside a river. The whole compact town emblem fills about 68% of the frame with generous dark teal negative space, keep all architecture and leaf inside a central circular-safe area. Excellent separation and silhouette at 48–64 pixels. Background opaque and full bleed to square corners; don't draw a square border or OS rounded corners. No text, no letters, no caption, no watermark, no phone mockup. Deliver one standalone launcher icon, not a sheet or multiple icons.
concepts.description: Café, Gewächshaus und Fluss als kleine Weedtopia-Stadt. Vermittelt den Aufbauaspekt; detailreicher als die anderen Entwürfe.

concepts.title: Weedtopia-W
concepts.prompt: Create one finished premium mobile game app icon for WEEDTOPIA, a cozy cannabis-growing city-building and management game. Square 1:1 native high resolution. Concept 3: THE WEEDTOPIA W. Make one huge unmistakable uppercase letter "W", the only text in the entire image. It has rounded, friendly chunky custom lettering, ivory-cream illuminated front faces and thick honey-gold bevels, with a strong dark petrol outline. The W should occupy the central 65% of the square and be legible instantly at 48 pixels. A single small but bold sculptural emerald cannabis leaf emerges from behind the top center of the W, as an accent that does not obstruct the letter. Inspired by a premium rounded hand-painted fantasy game wordmark, with plush tactile 2.5D surfaces, warm sunlight and jade-green leaves, refined game art rather than flat corporate vector art. An opaque full-bleed rich jade-to-petrol blue-green background with a soft turquoise halo gives very strong contrast. No outer frame, no circular medallion, no OS rounded-square corners. Keep main lettering and leaf safely within a centered circular crop with breathing room. Do not include the full word Weedtopia or any other letters, numbers, writing, symbols, captions, watermark, phone mockup, or multiple icons. Deliver a single real launcher icon image.
concepts.description: Ein großes creme-goldenes W mit grünem Blatt. Mein Favorit als Markenicon: klarer Buchstabe und Anschluss an den Weedtopia-Schriftzug.

concepts.title: Goldener Grinder
concepts.prompt: Create one finished premium mobile game app icon for WEEDTOPIA, a cozy cannabis-growing city-building and management game. Square 1:1 native high resolution. Concept 4: THE GOLDEN GRINDER. One very large closed two-piece cylindrical herb grinder in an appealing isometric three-quarter view, tilted so its top is clearly visible. Its broad lid has a single large emerald cannabis leaf embossed in deep green enamel with a gold outline. Body made of warm gold, thick ridged silhouette, no micro-engraving. Two chunky jade-green leaves behind it subtly frame the grinder. Rich opaque deep petrol-blue background with a restrained turquoise aura, warm sunshine highlights and soft grounded shadow. Luxury but welcoming, hand-painted polished 2.5D mobile game inventory art, tactile rounded shapes. This should be a distinct object icon, not a coin, not a leaf medallion and not a chest. Keep the single grinder visually dominant and fill about 65–70% of the canvas with clean breathing room, all important parts safely inside a centered circular crop. The grinder and leaf should be identifiable in a 48–64 pixel icon with strong contrast and simple shape hierarchy. Full-bleed square opaque background, no transparent corners, no baked OS rounded-square outline. No wording, no letters, no numbers, no smoke, no characters, no caption, no watermark, no phone mockup, no grid. A single actual standalone game launcher icon.
concepts.description: Ein goldener Grinder mit Blattprägung. Greift Produktion, Wirtschaft und die Grinder-Währung des Spiels auf.
